question: Which of the following missions led to the establishment of a National Biobank at the CSIR–Institute of Genomics and Integrative Biology (IGIB), New Delhi, in July 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Phenome India Project**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Phenome India Project**, a large-scale health cohort study, led to the formal establishment of the **National Biobank** at the **CSIR–Institute of Genomics and Integrative Biology (IGIB)** in **New Delhi** in **July 2025**.
 
• Launched by the **Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)**, the **Phenome India-CSIR Health Cohort Study** is a first-of-its-kind pan-India initiative designed to collect comprehensive **phenotypic** and **genetic data**.
 
• The mission aims to identify specific risk factors for **cardio-metabolic diseases**, such as **diabetes**, **cardiovascular ailments**, and **hypertension**, which are increasingly common in the **Indian population**.
